svg.title: Container Apps and Functions topology
svg.desc: Topology showing claims traffic entering Container Apps APIs, durable messages reaching workers, events triggering Azure Functions, and managed identity accessing secrets.

g.aria-label: HTTPS claim requests: http-intake to api
durable work commands: api to messages
long-running claims work: messages to workers
secretless dependency access: identity to api
secretless dependency access: identity to functions
Service node: Managed identity and secrets

svg.text: HTTP APIs and long-running workers share a Container Apps environment while event handlers scale independently in Functions.
